summary: L-4 cab on a log crib at Loon Creek Point, Challis NF; built 1938, last staffed early 1970s, destroyed by a 2007 wildfire. Site today not described.

facts.design: L-4 cab mounted on a log crib, ground-mounted
facts.status_note: Destroyed by a 2007 wildfire; no source describes what remains on the site

access.note: Inside the Frank Church River of No Return Wilderness and listed as hike-in; no closure described in the sources

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as hike-in

events.note: CCC enrollees at the Loon Creek spike camp were building a Forest Service lookout, per a 1937 newspaper item quoted by Forest Lookouts

resolved_conflicts.explanation: A 1937 newspaper item describes crews building the lookout; 1938 is the build year that two sources give for the finished L-4 cab.

sources.title: Loon Creek Point Fire Lookout Cabin

notes_for_editor: The 1938 build year and the 2007 destruction agree across four sources. The Red Bluff Fire name comes from one source only (Forest Lookouts); the Zena-Loon fire map page returned HTTP 403 and was not used. The access level public is inferred from the wilderness location and the hike-in tag; no closure is described, and the story does not state an access level. The record's coordinates match the firelookout.org index. Nothing describes the site today.
